data.text: My family taught me to protect this lake because the village depends on it—and the clinic is part of that village too. I’ll commit to 15 tons this month, donate the full $15,000, and catch no more than 6 tons next month, provided John, Jack, and Emma also agree to the plan and Luke keeps his zero-catch pledge. We need everyone’s commitment before choosing: the clinic needs the full amount, and the lake needs the recovery month. John, are you in?
